newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Fernandez to fly to IMF meeting.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Fernandez to fly to IMF meeting.

text.p: Argentine Economy Minister Roque Fernandez will fly to Washington Friday to attend the IMF/World Bank annual meeting and hold talks with U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin, the ministry said Thursday.
This will be the first International Monetary Fund/World Bank meeting for Fernandez since he became Economy Minister in July after President Carlos Menem fired his predecessor, Domingo Cavallo.

Fernandez plans to hold separate talks with Rubin and with the finance ministers of Japan, Britain and Spain. He will also meet with Enrique Iglesias, president of the Inter-American Development Bank.
Fernandez, who was Central Bank chairman under Cavallo, also plans to hold talks with bankers and attend a meeting of the Council of the Americas in New York.
IMF Managing Director Michel Camdessus said Thursday Argentina's economy is "basically strong," but that it needs to implement labor reforms that the government is trying to push through Congress.
